caveats: a handful of games: no inference; the coverage columns are mechanics, the P&L and CLV columns are anecdotes
the availability rule trades on a board that is older at the decision instant than the few boards the control can use (quote age block); the 900 s guard bounds it, the drift is reported
archival quotes are displayed quotes: nothing here shows that an order would have filled at the sealed price or size
settled P&L, CLV and drift use the final archives; none of it was available to the selection
retrospective reconstruction runs the sealer at the first minute of each window with commit-time filters, so it reproduces what a live sealer would have written; it is still uncounted

overlap.reading: descriptive; each lane keeps its own ledger and exposure caps, so a shared contract is two separate shadow positions

paired.check: the availability rule is a superset of the strict rule: games_only_control_evaluated must be 0 and the common games must agree contract for contract

bootstrap.method: game-clustered bootstrap of the per-game mean difference

per_game_net_pnl_difference.reading: t60a minus control, summed over a game's settled trades (0 for a game a lane did not evaluate); descriptive, not evidence of an edge until the sealed ledgers carry it

projection_accuracy_all_games.rule: the denominator is every game with settled forecasts. TRADED, EVALUATED_NO_TRADE, EXCLUDED_* and NO_SEAL games are all scored; a trade decision, a missing board or a lane exclusion never removes a game from the accuracy evaluation

scope: Retrospective reconstruction of the control and of the PRIMARY T-60 availability lane over the games since 2026-10-20 on the final archives (uncounted, descriptive); the two share the T-60 checkpoint, the thresholds, the costs and the caps, so the board-selection rule is the only difference. Prospective, counted evidence is read only from each lane's own sealed ledger (control start 2026-10-24T06:00Z; t60a start 2026-10-27T06:00:00Z); archival quotes are displayed quotes, not proven live fills.
